equivalency_validation_results.error_reason: SQL Equivalency tool returned ERROR with 'uniqueID' error on all 7 calls. Appears to be a service infrastructure issue.

manual_interventions.reason: DMS MCP tool was completely unresponsive (metadata model creation timeouts). All 7 statements manually converted with lowercase schema object names per DMS_FAILURE_MANUAL_CONVERSION_WITH_LOWERCASE_SCHEMA rule.
conversions_applied: All table/column names → lowercase (Products → products, ProductId → productid, etc.)

Integer division in ROUND → Cast to numeric (::numeric) for proper PostgreSQL decimal division
